description: Lists the products in the endoflife.date snapshot (runtimes, frameworks, databases, operating systems and more), with their ids for use in the other tools. Filter by a search text and/or category.

category.description: Only this category: framework, lang, database, os, server-app, app, service, device or standard.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 100).

query.description: Text to search in product ids, names and aliases, for example "net", "angular" or "postgres".

name: list_products
title: List products
